  fleet
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Usage: fleet [-h] [--version] COMMAND ...

Manage enrolled machines.

commands:
  COMMAND
    addons     List optional manager extensions.
    backups    Create or list saved file copies.
    check      Fetch new update results.
    configure  Reopen the enrollment wizard.
    content    Show the content checkout and Git state.
    diff       Show pending file differences.
    doctor     Check this machine and name any fixes.
    domain     Show or choose content additions.
    groups     Show or switch optional content.
    help       Show command help.
    machines   Manage saved machine connections.
    pins       Show or set exact tool versions.
    profile    Show saved machine choices.
    rollback   List backups or restore one.
    secrets    List secret names as set or unset.
    status     Show saved state without network requests.
    topology   Show this machine’s connection tree.
    tui        Open the full-screen terminal interface.
    uninstall  Remove Fleet and its managed files.
    update     Pull repositories and apply saved choices.
    version    Show manager and content versions.

global options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --version    show manager and content versions, then exit
